prompts.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background artwork for a polished original underwater slot called Abyss Protocol. NO TEXT, NO LOGOS, NO UI, no reels, no borders. Wide landscape approx 1600x1000. View from inside a beautiful mysterious brass-and-dark-blue deep sea research station through an immense round observation window. Outside, a curious giant translucent cyan and violet jellyfish glows gently above a tiny ornate bathyscaphe, deep ocean silhouettes and tiny floating luminous particles. Window has restrained antique bronze mechanical details at sides; lighting sophisticated and atmospheric, high-end stylized 3D videogame concept art, exquisite translucent materials, readable main jellyfish silhouette centered in middle 50 percent of canvas, capable of cropping to a portrait game catalog cover. Colors midnight #071524, luminous cyan, violet, muted brass. Bottom quarter fades smoothly into solid dark navy #071524 to transition into the reels. No aggressive horror, no realistic people, no stock photo look, no text or fake interface baked in. Visually consistent with beautifully rendered bronze diving gear and glowing marine specimens.
prompts.symbols: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite ATLAS, not a mockup. One image with EXACTLY 5 columns and 2 rows of ten equal SQUARE tiles; full canvas aspect 5:2, approx 2500x1000. Uniform solid very dark navy #071524 background throughout all tiles, no grid lines, no framing, no labels, no typography whatsoever. Each separate object centered in its exact tile with 12 percent padding on all sides, entirely inside its tile, no objects crossing boundaries, consistent visual scale. Premium polished high-end stylized 3D underwater expedition slot art, exquisite hand-crafted shapes, crisp readable silhouettes at small sizes, polished brass and glass, soft cyan and violet bioluminescence. Top row LEFT TO RIGHT: 1 intricate iridescent blue-orange living nautilus with curled shell and visible short tentacles; 2 ornate antique brass pressure gauge on a short curved pipe, ivory dial; 3 sealed upright glass marine sample capsule with violet glowing plankton and bronze ends; 4 graceful blue-violet bioluminescent jellyfish with short flowing tentacles; 5 articulated retro mechanical diving glove bronze with blue leather. Bottom row LEFT TO RIGHT: 6 luminous violet sea anemone on a small coral rock; 7 brass portable sonar instrument with circular cyan radar display; 8 beautiful golden copper fossil ammonite spiral on stone; 9 majestic front-facing ornate bronze diving helmet with thick glass glowing violet and tiny silver rivets, no face inside; 10 ornate round submarine hatch with radial metal locking spokes, opening onto a brilliant cyan underwater light. No 777, stars, bells, card ranks, gems, emojis, UI buttons, writing, random extra symbols or realistic photo cutouts. The final atlas must have all TEN distinct items at the specified exact positions, TWO rows FIVE columns, identical square tile sizes, each on exactly the same solid dark navy background. This will be cropped mathematically into ten separate game symbols.
